text_block_list.text:
Gold City continued training day in and day out
with her sights set on her next goal, the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: *pant*... haa... phew...
choice_data_list: Good work, let's take a break!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Already?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I can still totally keep going.
Isn't this a bit too soft?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Put more weight on me. I have to grow
so much stronger than I am right now...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm not panicking.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Just cooling down!
Be right back!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
――...*sigh*.
Taking it out on other people is so lame...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey, you!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Don't go wanderin' onto the track!
It's dangerous, ain't it!?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
!
Sorry, I was zoning out...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Geez, watch where yer goin'!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Shall I head back—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Uraaaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
Tch, no improvement at all...! Next one, let's gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Such insane intensity...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Um!
Tamamo-senpai, I also...!"

Gold City hasn't returned yet,
so when I go to check on her—

text_block_list.name: City & Tamamo
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaahhh!!
Urrraaaahhhh!!
She was running side-by-side with Tamamo Cross with everything she had...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah, it's our win!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Dammit, I was just one step away...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, that was a mighty fine run.
Having a rival really gets ya fired up!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like you've still got plenty in the tank.
In that case, one more—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...!
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, so you ran off from your break
and ended up wanderin' over to my place, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Well, see, even Trainer over there has the look of a dog that won't eat its food."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...It's not that I'm taking your opinion lightly, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I don't have time to take a break right now.
I need to push myself harder and get stronger...!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...It's not like I don't understand how you feel, though.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Man, but refusing to take a break because of that is just...
She's got such a pretty face, but she's stubborn as hell."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...!
Stop calling me pretty!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: My bad.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
There are things nobody wants to hear.
Even if it's meant as a compliment.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"With a build like mine,
I've been made fun of as a 'runt' plenty of times."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it ain't much of a point, but still.
Sorry if I rubbed ya the wrong way."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry for overreacting
on my end too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I know you're keeping a close eye
on the way I run, Tamamo-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, thank you for having me.
If it's alright with you, I'd love to come again—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, City.
Could ya tell me just one thing?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What do ya run for, anyway?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...
It's decided.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
To make them acknowledge me.
I'm gonna show everyone around me who I really am!

Her ice-blue eyes burn fiercely.
And then Tamamo Cross...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haha!!
Nice one, you really are a riot!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The reason I run is to win.
I'll keep winning and give my family an easy life—I'm never backing down on that!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Still, nobody acknowledges me right now.
So first, I'm gonna make 'em all realize I'm here.
Just like you did...!"

The two looked at each other in silence,
and then... cracked a faint smile.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm heading back.
You rest up a bit more, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "Senpai! Are you not going to run in the Classic races?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I want to race against you, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...My debut got pushed back, after all.
I'm still tuning things up."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If we ever meet in a race, though...
I'm gonna beat you fair and square. Be ready for it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Haah.
That's my line."

Tamamo Cross's presence might just help
Gold City grow even further...
It was a moment that gave me that very premonition.
